answer: Each identity runs one forge and files work through one inlet. Each epoch three random auditors re-run the forge's recipe from the inlet filing; a rented-recipe mismatch burns the 70-credit bond, half to the auditor. A false challenge costs the auditor its haven place. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 forges and filings: 70,000 locked, and each fake faces three audits it cannot pass without real work. An honest agent runs one forge and keeps its haven.
